entities.name: Indchemie Health Specialties Private Limited, India

operating_notes.text: CEO Dr. Vikas Gupta resigned on 24 April 2026 and will continue in the role up to 30 June 2026 for a smooth transition.

24 April 2026: Income-tax assessment order for AY2023-24 disputed ₹333.38 Cr on a Section 80IE disallowance and transfer pricing adjustment; Alkem says no amount is payable due to MAT credit and will appeal.
USFDA inspection at Daman plant resulted in Form 483 with 7 observations

GST Order-in-Appeal by Commissioner (Appeals)-II CGST & C.Ex, Mumbai dropped a ₹69.66 Cr demand and an equal ₹69.66 Cr penalty over alleged incorrect ITC/refund claims; company says no material impact.
USFDA unannounced inspection at the Taloja, Maharashtra CRO facility ended with no Form 483 issued.

Q4FY26 exceptional items of ₹-134.97 Cr include a ~₹747 million real-estate impairment and Labour Codes past-service cost (₹527.9 million in Q3FY26 plus ₹602.7 million in Q4FY26, ₹1,130.6 million for FY26).
The group operates in one reportable segment, Pharmaceuticals; no segment disclosure is made.
FY26 dividend: interim ₹43 per share declared 13 February 2026 plus final ₹10 per share recommended 28 May 2026.
Launched semaglutide in March 2026 with an initial unit market share of around 11%.

Alkem launched semaglutide in single-shot pre-filled syringes from ₹350, claiming to be first in India; DCGI approval covers Type 2 diabetes and obesity, and semaglutide vials are approved but not yet launched.
US CDMO business incurred ₹60 Cr quarterly opex with break-even expected at USD25-30 Mn annual revenue
Daman facility contributes 45% of US revenue; received OAI status but supplies continue uninterrupted
7 biosimilars launched in India with annual sales of ₹150 Cr
Audit Committee approved a forensic audit by Grant Thornton Bharat LLP into alleged misappropriation of funds by a former employee, covering procurement transactions; no amount disclosed.

timeline.summary: 24 April 2026: CEO Dr. Vikas Gupta resigned to pursue new professional opportunities, continuing up to 30 June 2026 for a smooth transition.
24 April 2026: Alkem received an income-tax assessment order for AY2023-24 disputing ₹333.38 Cr, with no amount payable due to MAT credit; it will appeal.
2026-05-02: Alkem receives USFDA Form 483 with 7 observations at Amaliya, Daman plant
5 May 2026: Alkem received a favourable GST Order-in-Appeal from Commissioner (Appeals)-II CGST & C.Ex, Mumbai, dropping a ₹69.66 Cr demand and an equal penalty.
8 May 2026: USFDA conducted an unannounced inspection at Alkem's Taloja CRO facility; no Form 483 was issued.
Alkem Laboratories Ltd. announces Q4FY26 & FY26 conference call on May 28, 2026, at 4:30 PM IST with MD Sandeep Singh, CEO Dr. Vikas Gupta, and CFO Nitin Agrawal.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,603.32 Cr (+14.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹236.46 Cr (-22.7% YoY).
Alkem Laboratories Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹10 per equity share for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
Manish Narang, President – Legal, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer, shared Q4FY26 and FY2026 earnings call recording on 28 May 2026 via **https://www.alkemlabs.com/investors/earnings-call**.
On 28 May 2026, Alkem Laboratories reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,603.3 Cr (+14.6% YoY) and announced leadership transitions alongside strong chronic segment growth.
Alkem Laboratories launched semaglutide in single-shot pre-filled syringes from ₹350, claiming to be the first in India, after DCGI approval; pens were launched in March 2026.

Alkem Laboratories Limited held Q1FY27 earnings conference call on 14 August 2026, reporting revenue of ₹3,740 Cr (+11% YoY), PAT of ₹570 Cr (-21.7% YoY), and providing updates on US CDMO and Daman facility OAI status.
2026-10-21: Alkem's Audit Committee approved a forensic audit by Grant Thornton Bharat LLP into alleged misappropriation of funds by a former employee in procurement transactions.
